scope_note: SCOPE-completeness spine for ai-codebase-gap-analysis, mined via the feature-surface lens from the FEATURE surface of ['codegpt', 'kodus', 'semgrep', 'sonarqube', 'sourcery']. Complements the robustness spine (cluster_fixes.py). Does NOT predict project-specific product direction — that is strategy, not completeness.

required.what: Generate PR/code review summaries, high-level feedback, and line-level suggestions on code changes.
required.day1_tell: Open a test pull request and confirm the product generates a review summary plus at least one line-level suggestion on the diff.

required.what: Let users choose or configure LLM providers/models, including OpenAI-compatible endpoints and major hosted providers.
required.day1_tell: Open model/provider settings and confirm you can select or configure at least two LLM providers or models, including an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

required.what: Support user-managed API keys/credentials so teams control provider spend and access.
required.day1_tell: Add a user-managed API key in settings and run a review confirming the request uses that configured key.

required.what: Expose review, commit, hook, or local analysis capabilities through command-line tooling.
required.day1_tell: Install the CLI and run a local review or analysis command against a repository.

required.what: Connect to source-control platforms and review pull requests or code scanning results in developer workflows.
required.day1_tell: Connect a GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repository and confirm the product can access and review an open pull request.

required.what: Allow teams to tune analysis with rules, configs, prompts, quality gates, or review settings.
required.day1_tell: Create or edit a custom rule/config file and confirm it changes the review output on a test repository.

required.what: Analyze code for defects, smells, security issues, or policy violations beyond LLM-generated feedback.
required.day1_tell: Run a scan on a repository with a known lint/security/code-smell issue and confirm the product reports it outside of generic LLM prose.

required.what: Block or flag changes based on defined code quality/security thresholds.
required.day1_tell: Configure a quality threshold, run it on a failing change, and confirm the product marks the change as failed or blocked.

required.what: Detect security issues and dependency/supply-chain risks, including SBOM-oriented capabilities.
required.day1_tell: Scan a project with a known vulnerable dependency and confirm the product reports the dependency or supply-chain risk.

required.what: Support parsing and analysis across multiple programming languages and language versions.
required.day1_tell: Run analysis on a repository containing at least two programming languages and confirm both are parsed or reported on.

required.what: Offer deployable/self-managed options for teams needing control over infrastructure, data, or compliance.
required.day1_tell: Find and follow the self-hosted deployment instructions, then confirm the service starts in your own environment.

required.what: Support secure credential handling, SSO, vault-backed secrets, or OS credential storage.
required.day1_tell: Configure SSO, vault-backed secrets, or OS credential storage and confirm credentials are not stored as plain text in the app.

required.what: Run analysis or reviews automatically from CI pipelines, GitHub Actions, agents, or pre-commit hooks.
required.day1_tell: Add the product to a CI pipeline or GitHub Action and confirm it runs automatically on a commit or pull request.

required.what: Surface review outcomes, token/usage data, scan results, project health, or contributor/license visibility.
required.day1_tell: Open the reporting/dashboard area and confirm it shows review results, scan findings, usage, or project health metrics.
